name: Profile switcher
author: Brett
description: A compact widget for any toolbar or banner: shows the build profile in use (colour dot, open/running counts) and filters every builds table by profile. Builds of every profile are always loaded; the switcher only hides what is not picked (profile-filter@1). Tap it for the list: All profiles (no filter) at the top, then every profile with its counts; tap one to work on it (it becomes the active profile, where new builds go, and the view shows only it), or tick several to show them together. Every bulk action acts only on the builds the filter shows. Right-click or the list's Place menu adds it to the toolbar or the banner. Settings → Plugins → Profile switcher: counts, compact/full, tones, which profiles are listed and in what order. REST, MCP and CLI: profiles-list, profile-current, profile-select, profile-filter, profile-visible.
